items.headline: Quoreka expands AI document-verification tool Doccurate
items.summary: Per CTRM Center, Quoreka reported its Doccurate AI invoice-verification tool is now live at a major agricultural trading firm and a second metals-sector client, alongside broader API and risk-integration updates.

items.headline: EUDR compliance data eyed for CTRM systems
items.summary: CTRM Center argues the EU Deforestation Regulation, applying from 30 December 2026 to large operators, could push environmental due-diligence data into core CTRM platforms rather than staying a standalone compliance task.

items.headline: Capesize rates hit multi-year highs on disruptions
items.summary: The Baltic Dry Index jumped sharply this month as Pacific typhoons, strong iron ore and coal demand, and longer geopolitically-rerouted voyages tightened Capesize vessel supply, per Trading Economics and Reuters-sourced data.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market leans into blockchain
items.summary: A new market report projects commodity trade finance growing from $59.7bn to $81.45bn by 2030, driven by blockchain settlement and fintech players like MineHub bridging liquidity gaps for traders.
